title: UI/UX Graphic Designer | Remote | Brazil | Full-Time
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re a time management wizard.
  • You’re a team player
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DND, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

title: Sr. Desenvolvedor Back-end Java
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga

O projeto envolve a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento de uma plataforma robusta, sustentada por uma infraestrutura moderna baseada em APIs. title: Desenvolvedor PHP
description:
Descrição da vaga Desenvolvedor(a) PHP Pleno — Fluxxer

Sobre a Fluxxer


A Fluxxer é uma empresa de tecnologia focada em automação de processos, gestão operacional e eficiência para o varejo e atacado, com forte atuação em sistemas de fluxo, regras operacionais, logística e controle inteligente de dados.

Estamos em um projeto contínuo de modernização da nossa plataforma, evoluindo um sistema robusto para uma arquitetura mais escalável, performática e preparada para crescimento, com APIs bem definidas, frontend moderno e forte uso de boas práticas de engenharia de software.

Se você gosta de desafios reais, código limpo e ver suas entregas em produção gerando impacto direto no negócio, essa vaga é para você.


Informações da vaga


Cargo: Desenvolvedor(a) PHP Pleno

Modelo de atuação: 100% Remoto

Quantidade de vagas: 02

Modelo de contratação: PJ

Horário: Segunda a sexta, das 8h às 17h


O desafio

Você fará parte do time responsável pela modernização e evolução do sistema da Fluxxer, atuando tanto na manutenção do legado quanto no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, ajudando a construir uma base sólida para os próximos anos da plataforma.


Habilidades essenciais (obrigatórias)


Esperamos que você tenha experiência prática com:

PHP moderno e framework Laravel

Desenvolvimento Frontend com Vue.js

Bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL)

Uso de terminal Linux e acesso via SSH

Consumo e construção de APIs REST

Perfil proativo, com autonomia e vontade real de fazer o sistema evoluir

title: Engenheiro de Dados
description:
Transforme Dados em Estratégia e Inovação!


Você é apaixonado(a) por transformar dados em ativos estratégicos para os negócios? Tem domínio de Azure, Databricks e busca desafios em projetos de grande escala? Então essa oportunidade é para você!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para liderar o desenvolvimento e a sustentação de pipelines modernos e eficientes em ambiente cloud. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta, colaborar com times multidisciplinares e impactar diretamente decisões estratégicas por meio de dados de qualidade.


Suas responsabilidades incluirão:


Desenhar, implementar e otimizar arquiteturas e processos de engenharia de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.

Desenvolver e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Azure (Data Factory, Synapse

Analytics, Databricks, Data Lake, SQL Database).

Estruturar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) de alta performance e confiabilidade.

Atuar na modelagem de dados, integração de sistemas e governança da informação.

Garantir boas práticas de performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares e stakeholders internacionais.

Participar de reuniões e apresentações em inglês avançado.


Idioma: Inglês avançado

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python + React)
description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain full-stack applications, including backend services, APIs, and user-facing web interfaces.
  • Develop backend systems using Python ; build responsive front-end components using JavaScript/TypeScript.

title: Tech Lead | Analytics & AI
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead de Analytics & AI para liderar tecnicamente um time multidisciplinar, atuando na construção de soluções baseadas em dados, machine learning e IA aplicada a problemas reais de negócio.

Essa posição é para quem combina excelência técnica, visão arquitetural e liderança, atuando próximo ao time, produto e negócio para tomar decisões técnicas, orientar o time e garantir entregas escaláveis e de qualidade.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time, com protagonismo na definição de padrões de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e boas práticas
  • Apoiar o time na resolução de desafios técnicos, removendo impedimentos e orientando decisões
  • Atuar hands-on em demandas estratégicas ou de maior complexidade
  • Traduzir necessidades de produto e negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis, sustentáveis e alinhadas ao roadmap
  • Planejar e acompanhar entregas técnicas, participando de estimativas, prazos e priorização
  • Monitorar indicadores de engenharia e qualidade, mitigando riscos técnicos
  • Garantir práticas de qualidade, como code reviews, testes automatizados e documentação
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, com 1:1s, feedbacks e apoio à evolução profissional
  • Atuar como ponte entre tecnologia, produto e negócio, apoiando alinhamentos e decisões técnicas
  • Trabalhar em parceria com a área de arquitetura na construção de provas de conceito (PoCs) e na análise de viabilidade técnica de soluções.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados, Machine Learning e ML em produção (pipelines batch/streaming, deploy e monitoramento)
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas de dados e ML, avaliando trade-offs
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados (modelagem OLTP/OLAP, Data Lakes, integrações e SQL)
  • Atuação fullstack, com backend em Python e integração com frontend em React e/ou Angular
  • Domínio de boas práticas de arquitetura de software e atuação como referência técnica do time
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de IA agêntica, agentes, MCPs e integração com plataformas de IA (ex.: AWS Bedrock).
  • Experiência com IA Generativa (RAG, embeddings, chains/agents)
  • Vivência com frameworks de agentes (ex.: LangChain, LangGraph ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em Data Mesh, governança de dados e sistemas de alta escala


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT


BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

  • Atuar hands-on em demandas estratégicas ou de maior complexidade
  • Traduzir necessidades de produto e negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis, sustentáveis e alinhadas ao roadmap
  • Planejar e acompanhar entregas técnicas, participando de estimativas, prazos e priorização
  • Monitorar indicadores de engenharia e qualidade, mitigando riscos técnicos
  • Garantir práticas de qualidade, como code reviews, testes automatizados e documentação
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, com 1:1s, feedbacks e apoio à evolução profissional
  • Atuar como ponte entre tecnologia, produto e negócio, apoiando alinhamentos e decisões técnicas
  • Trabalhar em parceria com a área de arquitetura na construção de provas de conceito (PoCs) e na análise de viabilidade técnica de soluções.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados, Machine Learning e ML em produção (pipelines batch/streaming, deploy e monitoramento)
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas de dados e ML, avaliando trade-offs
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados (modelagem OLTP/OLAP, Data Lakes, integrações e SQL)
  • Atuação fullstack, com backend em Python e integração com frontend em React e/ou Angular
  • Domínio de boas práticas de arquitetura de software e atuação como referência técnica do time
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de IA agêntica, agentes, MCPs e integração com plataformas de IA (ex.: AWS Bedrock).
  • Experiência com IA Generativa (RAG, embeddings, chains/agents)
  • Vivência com frameworks de agentes (ex.: LangChain, LangGraph ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em Data Mesh, governança de dados e sistemas de alta escala

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

Outras localidades – Remoto

title: Devops Engineer (Projeto Internacional)
description:
Se você busca uma oportunidade na área de Tecnologia da Informação, tem organização, boa comunicação e vontade de crescer, essa vaga 100% remoto e CLT, pode ser para você.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida com DevOps atuando com Saas/PaaS e plataformas de serviços;
  • Experiência com CI/CD, plataforma Azure (Kubernetes / SQL / AppGW / Key Vault);
  • Experiência com Jira e distribuição Linux;
  • Experiência com suporte operacional por meio de solução de problemas e análise de erros, garantindo o registro e monitoramento eficientes e solução de problemas confiável;
  • Idioma Inglês Avançado (terá inteirações internacionais).


Responsabilidades:

Esse profissional será responsável por provisionar, configurar e manter ambientes em nuvem, utilizando ferramentas (principalmente plataforma Azure) para garantir escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança dos sistemas.

Além disso, é essencial o domínio em administração de sistemas Linux, com conhecimento em roteamento, estratégias de firewall e gestão de certificados. O profissional também atuará no suporte operacional, realizando análises de erros e troubleshooting, assegurando que os ambientes estejam corretamente logados, monitorados e performando de forma eficiente. Ter conhecimento ou interesse em práticas de CI/CD é valorizado, assim como disposição para trabalhar com ferramentas colaborativas como SharePoint e Jira.

Buscamos alguém com perfil proativo, analítico e orientado à automação, que contribua ativamente para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da infraestrutura


O que oferecemos:

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.
  • Pacote de benefícios completo - PLR, VR, Gympass, Previdência, Convênios, etc.

title: Analista de Dados - Google Analytics & GCP
description:
A Tech For TI está com oportunidade para Analista de Dados - Google Analytics & GCP , atuar em projeto de cliente AutoTech, focada no mercado B2B, presente em diversos países.


Buscamos um (a) Analista de Dados que seja a principal referência técnica da empresa no uso estratégico e tático do ecossistema Google para dados. O papel exige proficiência total no Google Analytics 4 (GA4) para extrair insights profundos do comportamento do usuário e uma base sólida no Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularmente o BigQuery, para manipular e analisar grandes volumes de dados. Este profissional será fundamental para a tomada de decisões baseada em dados em toda a organização.

Principais atividades:

- Liderar em Google Analytics (GA4):

- Gerenciar e otimizar totalmente a implementação e configuração do GA4, garantindo a mais alta qualidade e integridade dos dados de comportamento do usuário.

- Definir e manter o plano de mensuração completo (eventos, parâmetros, dimensões personalizadas) via Google Tag Manager (GTM).

- Liderar a análise de funis de conversão, performance de canais e modelos de atribuição, gerando recomendações diretas para Marketing e Produto.

- Governança de Dados via GCP/BigQuery:

- Ser o (a) ponto focal na utilização do Google BigQuery para ingestão, processamento e modelagem de dados web e transacionais em larga escala.

- Escrever e otimizar consultas SQL avançadas, realizando operações de ETL/ELT para combinar dados de GA4 (via exportação direta), CRM e outras fontes.

- Monitorar e gerenciar recursos do GCP (Cloud Storage, BigQuery) para garantir eficiência e controle de custos.

Visualização e Comunicação:

- Desenvolver dashboards complexos e automatizados no Looker Studio (Data Studio), garantindo que os insights sejam claros, acionáveis e acessíveis aos líderes e equipes operacionais.

- Apresentar resultados analíticos de forma persuasiva, traduzindo métricas técnicas em impacto financeiro e estratégico.


Requisitos imprescindíveis:

- Os candidatos devem demonstrar proficiência e experiência comprovada nos seguintes pontos:

- Google Analytics (GA4): Avançado/Especialista em configuração, migração, auditoria e uso estratégico da plataforma (Relatórios Padrão e Análises Exploratórias).

- Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Familiaridade sólida com a plataforma GCP, incluindo Cloud Storage e IAM.

- BigQuery e SQL: Avançada para escrever, otimizar e gerenciar consultas SQL complexas em ambientes de Big Data (BigQuery).

- Visualização de Dados: Proficiência em Looker Studio (Data Studio) para construção de relatórios e painéis automatizados e performáticos.

- Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 3 a 5 anos como Analista de Dados, com foco direto em Web Analytics e Big Data.


Requisitos diferenciais:

- Conhecimentos e experiência com a linguagem de modelagem Looker ML.

- Certificações oficiais Google.

- Familiaridade com Python para análise e manipulação de dados.


Interessados podem se candidatar pelo Linkedin ou enviar CV para

- Liderar a análise de funis de conversão, performance de canais e modelos de atribuição, gerando recomendações diretas para Marketing e Produto.

- Ser o (a) ponto focal na utilização do Google BigQuery para ingestão, processamento e modelagem de dados web e transacionais em larga escala.

- Monitorar e gerenciar recursos do GCP (Cloud Storage, BigQuery) para garantir eficiência e controle de custos.

- Desenvolver dashboards complexos e automatizados no Looker Studio (Data Studio), garantindo que os insights sejam claros, acionáveis e acessíveis aos líderes e equipes operacionais.

- Apresentar resultados analíticos de forma persuasiva, traduzindo métricas técnicas em impacto financeiro e estratégico.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de software, dados e integrações com IA , garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, com vivência como referência técnica, arquiteto ou liderança técnica de times.

Conhecimentos Específicos:

  • Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos
  • APIs REST e boas práticas de API First
  • Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software
  • Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps
  • Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud)
  • Banco de dados relacionais, PostgreSQL ou equivalentes
  • NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes
  • Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes
  • IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações
  • Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes
  • DevOps: CI e CD, Git, GitFlow, Docker, Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código
  • Provedores de cloud, GCP, AWS ou Azure
  • Observabilidade (Logs estruturados, métricas e traces)
  • Atuação em ambientes distribuídos com foco em confiabilidade (Troubleshooting em produção)
  • Metodologias ágeis

title: Analista de risco de crédito
description:
Oportunidade para Analista de Risco Júnior para a Zupper | São Paulo




Sobre nós



No Grupo Kontik, tradição e inovação se conectam para impulsionar novas conquistas. Somos um hub de negócios com 09 marcas no segmento de viagens e turismo, atuando há mais de 70 anos no mercado. Aqui,

valorizamos pessoas empreendedoras e realizadoras, criando oportunidades para diferentes carreiras e jornadas.



Responsabilidades da vaga:


Analisar transações de compras online para identificação de riscos e possíveis fraudes.

Utilizar ferramentas antifraude para validação de pedidos.

Realizar contato com clientes por telefone, e-mail ou WhatsApp em casos de inconsistências.

Registrar análises e decisões conforme os procedimentos da área.



Requisitos:


Ensino médio completo.

Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

Perfil analítico, organizado e atento aos detalhes.

Proatividade, responsabilidade e facilidade para aprender.



Conhecimentos desejáveis:


Pacote Office, nível básico ou intermediário.

Experiência com ferramentas antifraude ou análise de risco.




Benefícios que fazem parte da nossa jornada:



  • Vale-Refeição em cartão flexível que pode ser utilizado como VR e VA;
  • Vale- Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica – Bradesco – sem custo para o Titular no Plano básico;
  • Assistência Odontológica - Bradesco – sem custo para o Titular no Plano básico;
  • Frutaria\" (entrega de frutas fresquinhas e higienizadas 02 vezes por semana para você ter uma alimentação ainda mais saudável);
  • Hoje a Festa é Sua! (Aniversariantes ganham o dia de folga);
  • WOW Experience Travel! – sorteio de diária, com acompanhante em hospedagens na região de São Paulo;
  • WOW na Sua Casa: sorteio de eletrodomésticos;
  • Você Muda & A Gente Ajuda! (Crédito em cartão benefício para ajudar na mudança de residência);
  • Sim, Aceito! (Crédito em cartão benefício para ajudar no Casamento);
  • Licença Casamento de 5 dias;
  • PAI! Você é nosso herói (Direito a licença paternidade de 30 dias após o nascimento do bebê);
  • BDay Filho (day off no dia do aniversário do filho de até 5 anos);
  • Sorteio WOW Experience Travel! – sorteio de uma diária, com acompanhante em hospedagens na região de São Paulo, litoral e interior de SP + vale divertido.
  • Sorteio WOW Na sua casa! – sorteio de eletrodomésticos.
  • Salvador, meu amô! – sorteio de viagem com acompanhante para conhecer Salvador, cidade onde o Grupo Kontik nasceu, e um cartão diversão.
  • Plataforma Kontik Trip – Passagens aéreas e hospedagem com descontos exclusivos para os colaboradores;
  • Pega à Visão (Auxílio para compra/troca de óculos ou lente de contato de grau);
  • Auxílio creche para mães com filhos até 6 anos;
  • Qualify Kontik- Plataforma online com diversos cursos online;
  • Wellhub (Gympass) ou Total Pass ;
  • Meu Amigo Vale Ouro (sua indicação se aprovado após o período de experiência e continuar na empresa rende um bônus para você);
  • Seguro de Vida - sem custo para o colaborador;
  • \"Diz Aí?\" (Canal aberto para sugestões, elogios ou para conversar conosco;
  • Ingressos para o cinema com a Cinemark (preços muito mais acessíveis e desconto em folha);
  • Convênio Farmácia.
  • Creditas - nossa parceira para realização de empréstimos consignado, oferecendo a opção de desconto diretamente em folha.
  • Uhuu me formei – benefício para quem se formou.
  • Dinbora (Creditas) - App de educação e saúde financeira gratuito.
  • Zenklub - Saúde mental, nutricional, financeira e carreira com consultas gratuitas para a titular e inclusão de dependentes com consultas com desconto.
  • Dog Life Saúde para pet - cachorro e gatos com valores acessíveis.
  • Bibi, Passei - Crédito no cartão Ifood




Vaga Presencial - Local: São Paulo – bairro da Bela Vista

Horário de trabalho: das 14h às 20h - escala 6x1 (home office aos finais de semana)

title: Assitente Comercial
description:
Vaga: Assistente Comercial (Part-time) – Imball America


Atuação remota | Inglês e Português | R$ 4.000 mensais (part-time)


A Imball America , braço responsável pelas operações na América do Norte de um grupo com sólida experiência internacional em máquinas e sistemas de embalagem para os setores alimentício, bebidas, farmacêutico e industrial, busca um(a) Assistente Comercial para apoiar os processos administrativos, comerciais e operacionais da operação.

Esta é uma posição part-time , com potencial concreto de crescimento para full-time , de acordo com desempenho e evolução das demandas.


-------------


Principais responsabilidades

Processos comerciais e administrativos

  • Elaboração, acompanhamento e organização de cotações (quotes)
  • Gestão de pedidos de compra (POs) e pedidos de venda
  • Emissão, controle e acompanhamento de faturas (invoices)
  • Organização de documentos comerciais e suporte direto ao time de vendas
  • Atualização de planilhas, sistemas e controles internos

Suporte operacional

  • Contato com parceiros logísticos, transportadoras e fornecedores
  • Acompanhamento de envios, prazos e documentação básica de embarques
  • Interface com times internacionais (EUA, Itália e parceiros externos)

Apoio a vendas e marketing

  • Suporte às atividades comerciais do dia a dia
  • Apoio em tarefas básicas de mídias sociais (postagens simples e organização de materiais)
  • Auxílio na preparação de apresentações e materiais comerciais


-------------


Perfil desejado

  • Alto nível de organização e atenção a detalhes
  • Facilidade com processos, números e acompanhamento de prazos
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Proatividade, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade
  • Interesse ou experiência em ambiente industrial, técnico ou B2B será considerado diferencial


-------------


Requisitos

  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado (leitura, escrita e comunicação profissional)
  • Experiência com rotinas administrativas, comerciais ou operacionais
  • Conhecimento em Excel / planilhas
  • Familiaridade com comunicação profissional por e-mail e interação com clientes e fornecedores


-------------


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com comércio exterior, logística ou indústria
  • Experiência prévia em suporte a vendas B2B
  • Noções práticas de marketing digital ou redes sociais corporativas


-------------


Formato e remuneração

  • Trabalho 100% remoto (Brasil)
  • Regime part-time
  • Remuneração: R$ 4.000 mensais (part-time)
  • Possibilidade de evolução para full-time , conforme desempenho e crescimento da operação

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products .
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

title: Database Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 NoSQL Database Engineer – MongoDB, Redis/Valkey, ElastiCache

Level: L3 Senior Engineer

Location: Brazil


About the Role:

We are seeking a senior NoSQL database engineer to lead the design and automation of distributed database systems across both cloud and Kubernetes environments. This role focuses on MongoDB, Redis or Valkey, and ElastiCache, with flexibility to expand into other NoSQL platforms as needed.

You will be responsible for designing secure, scalable architecture, managing both hosted and self-managed deployments, and building automation using Python, Terraform, Helm, and Argo CD. This is a senior-level role focused on infrastructure engineering, documentation, and project ownership.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, document, and prototype resilient NoSQL database platforms (MongoDB, Redis/Valkey, ElastiCache)
  • Architect and deploy self-managed clusters using Kubernetes operators, Helm charts, and Chef
  • Build automation pipelines for provisioning, backup/restore, scaling, and monitoring using Terraform and Python
  • Manage GitOps workflows with Argo CD for Kubernetes-based systems
  • Establish runbooks, SOPs, and deployment standards for L2 teams
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to translate business needs into infrastructure designs
  • Serve as an escalation point for deep diagnostics and incident response


Core Qualifications:

MongoDB

  • Replica sets, sharding, election behavior, and hidden node usage
  • WiredTiger internals, journaling, cache sizing, and performance tuning
  • mongodump / mongorestore workflows, backup retention ops best practices
  • LDAP / SCRAM integration, TLS, RBAC, and audit logging
  • Operational experience with MongoDB Atlas or DocumentDB


Redis / Valkey / ElastiCache:

  • Cluster and sentinel architecture, memory tuning, persistence models
  • Expiry strategies, eviction policies, replication, and failover behavior
  • Hands-on experience with Valkey on Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with AWS ElastiCache configuration, IAM, backups, and limitations


Automation and IaC:

  • Experience using Argo CD for GitOps-style deployment
  • Helm chart / Kustomize creation and management
  • Deep Terraform proficiency for cloud infrastructure automation
  • Strong Python skills to build reusable automation libraries and scripts


Infrastructure / Cloud:

  • Experience with one of AWS, Azure, or OCI cloud is a must
  • Understanding of cloud-native database deployments, IAM, secrets, network security
  • Strong grasp of Kubernetes networking, RBAC, Stateful Sets, volumes, node affinity


Operational Excellence:

  • Project ownership from design through delivery and L2 handoff
  • Strong documentation skills (SOPs, diagrams, runbooks)
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root cause analysis under pressure
  • Ability to mentor L2 engineers and oversee their execution


Bonus Skills:

  • Experience with DynamoDB, Cassandra, or other distributed NoSQL engines
  • Kubernetes secrets automation (Vault Agent, External Secrets)
  • Load and stress testing practices for NoSQL systems
  • Familiarity with hybrid cache/database designs and their tradeoffs

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer


About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join a high-impact engineering team working on a large-scale, enterprise-grade, multi-tenant web platform.

In this role, you will build and maintain a sophisticated web application using modern technologies, contributing to a codebase that prioritizes performance, scalability, code quality, and exceptional user experience .



Technical Stack - Core Technologies


  • Frontend: React 18, Next.js 14 (Pages Router), TypeScript
  • Styling: Linaria (CSS-in-JS)
  • State Management: React Context API
  • Backend/API: Next.js API Routes, Node.js
  • Headless CMS: Contentstack
  • Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress (E2E)
  • Build Tools: Webpack 5, Babel, Yarn 4 (Workspaces)

Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, ECR, Route53, ALB)
  • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  • Monitoring: Elastic APM
  • Caching: Redis
  • Analytics: mParticle, Adobe Target


Key Responsibilities - Development


  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and Next.js
  • Build and maintain reusable, well-typed component libraries with comprehensive test coverage
  • Integrate and manage content delivery workflows using a headless CMS


Code Quality & Best Practices


  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following established standards (strict TypeScript, ESLint, Stylelint)
  • Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive, high-quality feedback
  • Follow accessibility standards and best practices in semantic HTML


Collaboration


  • Work closely with designers, product managers, and engineering teams
  • Mentor junior engineers and lead technical knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and technical design discussions
  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to architectural decision records


Required Qualifications - Experience


  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
  • 2+ years working with Next.js or similar SSR frameworks
  • Strong experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and Node.js
  • Experience with CSS-in-JS solutions (Linaria, Styled Components, or similar)
  • Proven experience building and maintaining large-scale web applications
  • Experience working with headless CMS platforms


Technical Skills


  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript with strict typing
  • Strong understanding of React hooks, Context API, and component lifecycle
  • Experience with modern build tools such as Webpack and Babel
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services
  • Proficiency with Git and command-line workflows
  • Strong testing mindset with experience in Jest, React Testing Library, and E2E testing


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical challenges
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts
  • High attention to detail and strong commitment to code quality
  • Ability to balance technical debt and feature delivery in a fast-paced environment


Nice to Have


  • Experience in regulated or enterprise-scale platforms
  • Knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
  • Experience building design systems and component libraries
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (e.g., k6)
  • Experience using Storybook for component documentation
  • Knowledge of analytics platforms (mParticle, Adobe)
  • Experience with blue-green deployments
  • Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards

We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join a high-impact engineering team working on a large-scale, enterprise-grade, multi-tenant web platform.

In this role, you will build and maintain a sophisticated web application using modern technologies, contributing to a codebase that prioritizes performance, scalability, code quality, and exceptional user experience .



Technical Stack - Core Technologies


  • Frontend: React 18, Next.js 14 (Pages Router), TypeScript
  • Styling: Linaria (CSS-in-JS)
  • State Management: React Context API
  • Backend/API: Next.js API Routes, Node.js
  • Headless CMS: Contentstack
  • Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress (E2E)
  • Build Tools: Webpack 5, Babel, Yarn 4 (Workspaces)

Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, ECR, Route53, ALB)
  • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  • Monitoring: Elastic APM
  • Caching: Redis
  • Analytics: mParticle, Adobe Target


Key Responsibilities - Development


  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and Next.js
  • Build and maintain reusable, well-typed component libraries with comprehensive test coverage
  • Integrate and manage content delivery workflows using a headless CMS


Code Quality & Best Practices


  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following established standards (strict TypeScript, ESLint, Stylelint)
  • Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive, high-quality feedback
  • Follow accessibility standards and best practices in semantic HTML


Collaboration


  • Work closely with designers, product managers, and engineering teams
  • Mentor junior engineers and lead technical knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and technical design discussions
  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to architectural decision records


Required Qualifications - Experience


  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
  • 2+ years working with Next.js or similar SSR frameworks
  • Strong experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and Node.js
  • Experience with CSS-in-JS solutions (Linaria, Styled Components, or similar)
  • Proven experience building and maintaining large-scale web applications
  • Experience working with headless CMS platforms


Technical Skills


  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript with strict typing
  • Strong understanding of React hooks, Context API, and component lifecycle
  • Experience with modern build tools such as Webpack and Babel
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services
  • Proficiency with Git and command-line workflows
  • Strong testing mindset with experience in Jest, React Testing Library, and E2E testing


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical challenges
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts
  • High attention to detail and strong commitment to code quality
  • Ability to balance technical debt and feature delivery in a fast-paced environment


Nice to Have


  • Experience in regulated or enterprise-scale platforms
  • Knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
  • Experience building design systems and component libraries
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (e.g., k6)
  • Experience using Storybook for component documentation
  • Knowledge of analytics platforms (mParticle, Adobe)
  • Experience with blue-green deployments
  • Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards

title: Founder Associate (Growth)
description:
Location: Brazil (remote-first, with collaboration across Europe & Latin America)

Languages: English (fluent), Portuguese (fluent), Spanish (plus)


About OpenHealth

OpenHealth is building the infrastructure layer for health data , harmonizing and enriching laboratory results to power clinics, labs, insurers, and health-tech companies across Europe and Latin America. Our mission is to unlock the full value of medical data to enable better clinical decisions, preventive care, and AI-driven health innovation.

In 2025 OpenHealth raised it’s second institutional investment round, invested by selected leading Venture Capital firms from Europe:


What You Will Do

As Founder Associate , you will work directly with our CEO and act as a force multiplier across strategy, growth, project execution, operations, and fundraising . You will take full ownership of strategic initiatives , from definition to execution, and ensure that the most important projects move fast and deliver impact.

On a typical day, you may:

  • Lead high-impact strategic projects end-to-end with full ownership, such as new market entries, launch of new products, or strategic partnerships
  • Own project management for cross-functional initiatives, including scoping, timelines, stakeholder alignment, execution tracking, and delivery
  • Drive cross-functional programs across product, tech, growth, operations, and external partners
  • Support enterprise clients and strategic partners , including preparation of proposals, business cases, and pilots
  • Prepare board- and investor-ready presentations, decision memos, KPIs, and performance reports
  • Conduct market, competitor, customer, and investor research to support strategic decisions and positioning
  • Improve and scale internal processes and workflows , leveraging automation and AI where possible
  • Support fundraising and investor relations , including pitch materials, data rooms, investor outreach, and follow-ups
  • Act as a sparring partner to the CEO , helping prioritize initiatives, challenge assumptions, and execute across multiple workstreams simultaneously


Who You Are

You are a high-ownership, execution-focused strategic generalist who enjoys operating close to decision-making and turning strategy into results.

Your profile likely includes:

  • A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Medicine , or a similarly analytical field
  • 1–3 years of high-impact professional experience , e.g. in management consulting, investment banking, VC/PE, Big Tech, health-tech, or an early-stage venture-backed startup
  • Demonstrated experience in project management , owning complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders from planning to execution
  • A clear track record of leading strategic projects under full ownership , such as new market entries, international expansion, or go-to-market initiatives
  • Strong analytical and structured thinking , with the ability to turn complex problems into clear, actionable plans
  • Proven ability to work directly with C-level executives , driving initiatives with measurable impact
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability – you proactively identify problems and deliver solutions
  • Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-pressure environments with shifting priorities
  • Known for being reliable, persistent, and outcome-driven , with a strong bias toward execution


What Matters to Us

  • Strong motivation for the health industry , ideally with first exposure to healthcare, health-tech, life sciences, or medical data
  • Interest in how technology, data, and AI can meaningfully improve healthcare systems and patient outcomes
  • Ability to communicate effectively across business, technical, and medical stakeholders
  • A mindset of ownership, learning, and long-term impact


Languages & Location

  • English: Fluent
  • Portuguese: Fluent
  • Spanish: Plus / nice to have
  • Location: Brazil - São Paulo or Florianopolis (working closely with teams and partners in Europe & Latin America)


Why Join OpenHealth?

  • Work directly with the founders on company-defining initiatives
  • Take full ownership of strategic projects with visible impact
  • Exposure to international markets, enterprise clients, and investors
  • Steep learning curve across health-tech, data, AI, and B2B SaaS
  • Clear growth path into senior strategy, operations, or leadership roles

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
Required Skills & Qualifications:


  • Experience: 5+ years in a Software Engineering role.
  • Language: Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Software Development Proficiency: Strong background in software engineering with proficiency in GoLang or Python. You should be comfortable with object-oriented programming, data structures, REST API design, and writing testable, production-quality code (not just operational scripts).
  • DevSecOps Expertise: Proven experience implementing security best practices in a CI/CD environment. Familiarity with automated security scanning, secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault ), and compliance automation.
  • Containerization & Orchestration: Expert-level knowledge of Kubernetes , Docker , and Helm . Experience with Service Meshes like Istio or Linkerd is a plus.
  • Cloud Platforms: Proficiency with either GCP or AWS services.
  • CI/CD & GitOps: Deep experience with CI/CD platforms like GitLab/GitHub Actions and Jenkins .
  • Infrastructure as Code: Hands-on experience with Terraform .
  • Observability & Monitoring: Proven experience with the Prometheus/Grafana/Loki stack for monitoring, logging, and alerting.
  • Full Stack: A solid understanding of full-stack development principles to effectively support development teams.


Bonus Qualifications:


  • Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux .
  • Relevant certifications, such as AWS/GCP Certified.
  • Familiarity with other observability tools like Jaeger or OpenTelemetry.

title: Technical Support Engineer - Level 3 (VMWare)
description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.


Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare


The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.


What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned


What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English


Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)


Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.


Travel:

· 5-10%


If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by

calling .


Park Place Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V.


Park Place Technologies has an in-house recruiting team that focuses exclusively on the hiring needs of our company. We are not currently accepting additional third-party agreements or unsolicited resumes. If you would like to be considered as a preferred partner with Park Place

Technologies, please submit your detailed information to Any CVs submitted directly to hiring managers will be considered unsolicited and become the property of Park Place Technologies

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Natural/Adabas
description:
Profissional com sólida experiência em Natural e Adabas , atuando no mapeamento, análise e interpretação de dados provenientes de soluções que serão descontinuadas. Será responsável por garantir o correto entendimento das estruturas de dados e das regras de exibição implementadas nas aplicações nativas, viabilizando a migração dos dados para uma nova estrutura , mantendo fidelidade ao comportamento atual do sistema.


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar as bases de dados Adabas , incluindo estruturas de arquivos e descritores, com foco na extração e migração de dados.
  • Avaliar aplicações Natural com front-end nativo , identificando como os dados são transformados, consolidados e apresentados ao usuário.
  • Interpretar e documentar as regras de negócio implementadas no front , mesmo quando não explicitamente documentadas.
  • Traduzir as regras de exibição e transformação de dados para um formato compreensível e reutilizável na nova estrutura de dados .
  • Apoiar a definição do modelo de dados de destino , garantindo que os dados migrados reflitam corretamente a lógica atual de apresentação.
  • Atuar como elo entre as equipes técnicas, de dados e de arquitetura durante o processo de desligamento das soluções Natural/Adabas.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Forte domínio de Natural (batch e online) .
  • Experiência sólida com Adabas , incluindo leitura de estruturas, descritores e relacionamentos implícitos.
  • Conhecimento em controle de acesso e segurança em ambientes mainframe.
  • Capacidade avançada de leitura, análise e entendimento de código legado Natural .
  • Vivência com processos de extração, transformação e migração de dados .
  • Noções de modelagem de dados para ambientes modernos (relacional, analítico ou outro destino definido).


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Forte capacidade analítica para entender sistemas complexos e regras embutidas no código.
  • Facilidade em traduzir lógica técnica de front-end em regras de dados .
  • Comunicação clara para interação com times de dados, arquitetura e negócio.
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes, essenciais para garantir consistência na migração.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em projetos de desligamento (decommissioning) de sistemas Natural/Adabas.
  • Participação em iniciativas de modernização ou substituição de plataformas legadas .
  • Experiência em documentação de regras de negócio a partir de código-fonte.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: SAP Signavio Consultant
description:
SAP Signavio Consultant – Remote

Location : LATAM

Type : Contract


Job Description

title: Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Planejar, desenvolver, treinar, avaliar e monitorar modelos de Machine Learning, utilizando abordagens clássicas, NLP/NLI e LLMs;
  • Conduzir experimentações, provas de conceito (PoCs) e iniciativas de Discovery que apoiem a tomada de decisão e a automação de processos;
  • Explorar e analisar dados de negócio, realizando análises diagnósticas, preditivas e prescritivas;
  • Avaliar, estimar e acompanhar custos de implementação e operação em escala das soluções propostas;
  • Criar relatórios, dashboards e apresentações para comunicar resultados, insights e impactos dos projetos;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas de negócio e tecnologia, alinhando expectativas e defendendo boas práticas técnicas;
  • Propor inovações, apoiar decisões técnicas e contribuir para a evolução contínua das soluções de dados e IA.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Python avançado, com experiência em bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Pydantic, PyTorch e TensorFlow;
  • SQL intermediário a avançado, com atuação em bancos de dados relacionais;
  • Experiência com Databricks;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Machine Learning, incluindo técnicas de regressão, classificação, clustering e NLP;
  • Experiência com Large Language Models (LLMs), incluindo BERT, ASR, RAG, fine-tuning e modelos generativos.



Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com frameworks e APIs de ML e GenAI, como HuggingFace, LangChain, Azure OpenAI, DSPy, LangGraph, Vertex AI.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Role: Senior .NET engineer

Location : Remote

Job Overview

1.8-12+ years of experience developing software & systems for medium to large business environments

Strong experience in one or more programming languages, technologies and software platforms, such as C#, JavaScript, MS-SQL Server, Sybase, Angular/REACT.

2.At least 5+ year’s hands-on experience with one of the programming languages (e.g. C# using .NET Core)

3.Excellent problem solving and communication skills

4.Familiarity with multi-threading

5.Strong experience with good design principles (design patterns, cohesion/coupling, S.O.L.I.D.)

6.Experience with Services Oriented Architecture and RESTful services development

7.Hands on experience with microservices

8.Experience with writing clean and maintainable code using engineering best practices (unit testing using xUnit/nUnit, TDD, continuous integration and deployment (teamcity/octopus), automation, refactoring, version controlling etc.)

9.Strong experience working with other developers, quality engineers (QE), ops engineers and support engineers to ensure smooth deployment, continual operation and passion for developing good software.

10.Experience participating in design discussions with both technical and non-technical audiences.

11.Experience mentoring and coaching more-junior developers

12.Experience documenting business solution in technical documents and diagrams

13.Familiarity or experience with Agile engineering practices.

14.Hands on experience in Containerization of application. (Docker/Rancher/ Kubernetes) .

15.Hands on experience in AI Tools (like GitHub Copilot).”

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Data Science / Machine Learning


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Fluência em inglês ou espanhol.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Matemática, Física, Engenharia ou Estatística.
  • Experiência com Machine Learning, Data Mining e Feature Engineering.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python e SQL.
  • Vivência com Redes Neurais, Deep Learning e Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP).
  • Conhecimento em APIs de Large Language Models (LLMs) e frameworks como LangChain, OpenAI e Hugging Face.
  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem, como Azure ou AWS.
  • Conhecimentos em DevOps, MLOps e pipelines de dados e modelos.
  • Experiência com Git, CI/CD, Airflow, Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.


Requisitos Desejáveis


  • Mestrado ou PhD em Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com NLP, processamento de imagens e áudio.
  • Vivência no desenvolvimento de algoritmos escaláveis.
  • Experiência com dados não estruturados e uso de dashboards para visualização e análise.

description:
Java Backend Developer Tech Lead


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary


As a Java Tech Lead, you will make a significant contribution to the software development, maintenance and performance improvement. You'll be is involved in every stage of the digital product development lifecycle, from planning and architecture to release, distribution, and quality assurance.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Acts as the primary technical point of contact for the team towards the client;
  • Work in a dynamic team to provide solutions with Java and NodeJS applications;
  • Lead technical discussions with the team;
  • Ensure the team is operating efficiently in the technical activities;
  • Participate in the complete cycle of development from design, development, testing and deployment;
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches;
  • Ensures the team adheres to timelines, quality standards and best practices;
  • Ensure the project quality;
  • Help to unblock the other team members;
  • Provide technical mentorship to the team;
  • Work with the project manager to plan sprints and deliverables.

Essential Skills


  • Hands-on object oriented programming experience in Java;
  • Hands-on object oriented experience in Javascript/NodeJS;
  • Experience with AngularJS;
  • Experience in database development, both SQL and NoSQL: development, maintenance, analysis;
  • Experience developing Restful APIs;
  • Experience working in agile teams;
  • Experience with code versioning with Git;
  • Experience in AWS cloud services.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Development of secure web applications;
  • Experience with modeling, producing and consuming web services based APIs (RESTful or SOAP based);
  • Experience with Jenkins;
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence;
  • Experience with Gitlab Automation;
  • Experience with Apache Camel.

A Assurance IR está em busca de profissionais para atuação em projeto na indústria de telecomunicações, com foco na plataforma Salesforce Industries (Communications Cloud).


Sobre o projeto

Duração: 12 meses

Modelo: remoto

Horário: 9h às 18h

Possibilidade de absorção: sim


(1) Arquiteto de Soluções – Salesforce Industries (Communications Cloud)

- Requisitos obrigatórios: experiência sólida em Salesforce Industries; domínio do módulo Communications Cloud; experiência em desenho de soluções para telecom.

- Perfil: forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas; bom relacionamento e interação com cliente.

- Atuação: definição de arquitetura e soluções na plataforma; interface com stakeholders e times técnicos; suporte à tomada de decisão técnica.


(2) Analista Funcional – Salesforce Industries

- Requisitos obrigatórios: experiência na plataforma Salesforce; conhecimento em Communications Cloud.

- Diferenciais: vivência na indústria de telecom; experiência com condução de reuniões de requisitos

- Atuação: levantamento e documentação funcional; desenho de soluções; interface com cliente e áreas técnicas


(3) Desenvolvedor Salesforce Industries – Communications Cloud

- Requisitos obrigatórios: forte experiência em Salesforce Industries; conhecimento avançado em Communications Cloud; senioridade para atuar com baixa supervisão.

- Diferenciais: experiência na indústria de telecom.

- Atuação: desenvolvimento de demandas complexas; evolução e sustentação de soluções na plataforma.


(4) Desenvolvedor Salesforce Industries – Order Management (Vlocity)

- Requisitos obrigatórios: experiência em Salesforce Industries; conhecimento em Communications Cloud; experiência em Order Management (Vlocity).

- Diferenciais: vivência em telecom.

- Atuação: desenvolvimento e customização de soluções; atuação em demandas complexas com autonomia.

title: VMware/Broadcom VCI Instructor Japanese speaker
description:
Company Description

Go is a global platform connecting world-class technology training talent with those who need it most. By providing real-time access to top tech trainers across the globe, Go empowers leading cloud companies, technology resellers, and training providers to grow and thrive. The platform ensures effective learning and development, supporting organizations in their pursuit of technology excellence.


Role Description

This is a contract-based remote role for a VMware/Broadcom VCI Instructor who is fluent in Japanese. The instructor will deliver official VMware/Broadcom training to students and professionals in a virtual & live environment. Responsibilities include preparing training materials, facilitating engaging learning sessions, assessing participant progress, and providing feedback to support skill development. Effective communication and teaching techniques are essential for ensuring a high-quality learning experience.


Qualifications


  • It is mandatory that you must hold a valid  VMware Certified Professional (VCP)  certification.
  • Proficiency in Japanese with strong communication skills and the ability to engage learners effectively
  • Solid understanding of course content structure
  • Proven experience or certification in VMware and/or Broadcom training programs
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and adapt to different learning styles
  • Familiarity with virtual training tools and platforms
  • Relevant teaching/training certification(s) is a plus
  • It is highly desirable that you have already passed the VMware Instructor Certification Workshop (ICW). This 5-day workshop, however we will provide all necessary training to become a VCI.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP Full Stack - PL/SR
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Software Engineer GENEXUS
description:
We are Bizmoni the Next Gen AI Super APP


Our genuine and passionate global business culture is 100% remote and fully cloud based with 60 team members, and spread out over more than 20 countries.


THIS IS YOUR CHANCE TO BECOME A CO CO-FOUNDER IN THE NEXT GLOBAL UNICORN!


If are skilled, a doer by nature, hands-on, self-motivated, disciplined, focused, and above all result driven and a demonstrated team player we want to meet you.


What we expect


  • You are a passionate and responsible person, flexible, and result driven.
  • YOU ARE A PUNCTUAL PERSON, IF NOT, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.
  • Conversational English and maybe proficient in Spanish and or Portuguese is a big plus but not a must.
  • You are organized and out-of-the-box problem solver, spontaneous, creative, and able to go straight to the point.
  • You are disciplined and able to work remotely, IF YOU ARE NOT PLEASE CO NOT APPLY
  • You are eager to reach goals and make things happen.
  • You have a Personal Computer with a Camera and a stable and reliable internet connection.
  • You love to move up your sleeves and get things done.
  • You are social and ethically responsible.
  • You understand that the new money is EQUITY, and you have the drive to build a Business with others, IF THIS IS NOT THE CASE PLEASE DO NOT APPLY
  • You are open to take Risks
  • You commit for 8 hours per week up to a possible 16 hours


Job Qualifications:


  • Experienced SENIOR GENEXUS developer
  • Writing clean, high-quality, high-performance, maintainable code
  • Develop and support software including applications, database integration, interfaces, and new functionality enhancements
  • Coordinate cross-functionally to insure project meets business objectives and compliance standards
  • Support test and deployment of new products and features
  • Participate in code reviews


Job Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field)
  • Experience in using GENEXUS .NET and .NET native development
  • Expertise in Object Oriented Design, Database Design, and XML Schema
  • Experience with Agile or Scrum software development methodologies
  • Ability to multi-task, organize, and prioritize work
  • +5 years work experience
  • Proficient in English or Spanish or both, Portuguese is a plus.


If you meet the requirements and looking for a flexible, futuristic organization where talent is admired and you are eager to become a CO FOUNDER here is your opportunity and we can't wait to meet you.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!
