title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack (JavaScript, React, Node.js)
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Typescript | React | Node


Modelo de contratação: PJ (sem benefícios)

Trabalho: 100% remoto

⏱ Dedicação: Fulltime


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

Frontend (React/Next.js)

  • Desenvolver interfaces dinâmicas com forte integração de APIs
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis utilizando hooks nativos do React (useState, useEffect, useContext, useCallback, useMemo)
  • Gerenciar estado global com Zustand
  • Trabalhar com TanStack Query para consumo eficiente de APIs
  • Utilizar shadcn/ui e Tailwind CSS para componentes


Backend (Node.js/Fastify)

  • Construir e manter APIs RESTful
  • Trabalhar com Drizzle ORM e PostgreSQL
  • Integrar serviços externos (Buckets, RabbitMQ)
Stack Tecnológica

Frontend

  • Next.js + React
  • TypeScript
  • Zustand (gerenciamento de estado)
  • TanStack Query
  • shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS


Backend

  • Node.js + TypeScript
  • Fastify
  • Drizzle ORM
  • PostgreSQL
  • RabbitMQ
  • Integração com Buckets/Storage
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript
  • Domínio de React (hooks, contexts, gerenciamento de estado)
  • Conhecimento em construção de APIs REST
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacional (PostgreSQL)
Diferenciais
  • Docker
  • Python (manipulação de arquivos)
  • Experiência com message brokers (RabbitMQ)


Maiores informações:

Desenvolvedor Full Stack Typescript | React | Node


Modelo de contratação: PJ (sem benefícios)

Trabalho: 100% remoto

⏱ Dedicação: Fulltime


O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

Frontend (React/Next.js)

  • Desenvolver interfaces dinâmicas com forte integração de APIs
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis utilizando hooks nativos do React (useState, useEffect, useContext, useCallback, useMemo)
  • Gerenciar estado global com Zustand
  • Trabalhar com TanStack Query para consumo eficiente de APIs
  • Utilizar shadcn/ui e Tailwind CSS para componentes


Backend (Node.js/Fastify)

  • Construir e manter APIs RESTful
  • Trabalhar com Drizzle ORM e PostgreSQL
  • Integrar serviços externos (Buckets, RabbitMQ)
Stack Tecnológica

Frontend

  • Next.js + React
  • TypeScript
  • Zustand (gerenciamento de estado)
  • TanStack Query
  • shadcn/ui + Tailwind CSS


Backend

  • Node.js + TypeScript
  • Fastify
  • Drizzle ORM
  • PostgreSQL
  • RabbitMQ
  • Integração com Buckets/Storage
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript
  • Domínio de React (hooks, contexts, gerenciamento de estado)
  • Conhecimento em construção de APIs REST
  • Experiência com banco de dados relacional (PostgreSQL)
Diferenciais
  • Docker
  • Python (manipulação de arquivos)
  • Experiência com message brokers (RabbitMQ)

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Important:

  • This is a full-time contractor position to work on EST timezone
  • Experience in iGaming, gambling, gaming, esports industry is required
  • Proven experience managing and growing a Discord community is required
  • Availability to start ASAP
  • Salary range USD 30,000 - USD 40,000


The Company:

This opportunity is with a well-established sweepstakes casino operating in multiple U.S. states. Their brands are continuously growing, and they are therefore seeking an experienced Social Media Manager with strong expertise in Discord to help expand their community engagement.


About the Role:

In this role, you will manage social channels across multiple platforms, with Discord as a primary focus.


You will own the day-to-day social and community operations for two of our client’s sweepstakes brands. Both brands operate in the sweepstakes / social casino space.


This role offers the opportunity to work closely with the marketing team as well as the company’s founders.


Essential Job Functions / Main Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Own and manage Discord communities for two brands, including:
  • Daily engagement and community interaction
  • Moderation and enforcement of community guidelines
  • Planning and running events, promotions, and announcements
  • Driving growth and retention within Discord
  • Manage social media channels across platforms such as X (Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram
  • Create, schedule, and publish social content aligned with brand voice and campaigns
  • Engage with users across social platforms and respond to comments and messages
  • Coordinate closely with marketing and leadership on launches, promotions, and community initiatives
  • Monitor community sentiment and provide feedback to the team


Skills & Qualifications:

  • Proven experience managing and growing a Discord community
  • Experience in the social casino, sweepstakes, iGaming/gambling, gaming, or similar industry is preferred
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms and best practices
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and owning projects end-to-end
  • Strong communication and community management skills
  • Strong English proficiency, both verbal and written



Important: This is a full-time contractor position to work on EST timezone

A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.

title: Representante Comercial Externo
description:
Buscamos talentos com experiência em venda de maquinas pesadas;


Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção e desenvolvimento de clientes e mercado;
  • Atualização e interação com CRM (gestão de clientes e projetos);
  • Elaboração de análises, comparativos e apresentações técnicas sobre equipamentos;
  • Elaboração de propostas e contratos e acompanhamento das fases do projeto até entrega dos equipamentos;
  • Atender e visitar os clientes, elaborar propostas, negociar, preencher contratos e acompanhar todas as fases da venda;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho e a aceitação dos produtos vendidos em conjunto com o time de Pós-Vendas.


Qualificações

  • Bons conhecimentos em Informática;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Experiência com ERPs;
  • Necessário experiência com vendas de máquinas pesadas (Bombas de Concreto).

title: NoSQL Database Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 NoSQL Database Engineer MongoDB RedisValkey ElastiCache

Location: Remote


About the Role

We are looking for a senior-level database engineer to lead the design, deployment, and automation of PostgreSQL and MySQL platforms across both cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes environments. This role requires strong experience building resilient systems using Terraform in AWSOCI as well as managing Kubernetes-native deployments using Helm and Argo CD

You will be responsible for prototyping new solutions, defining standards, and creating automation workflows that support highly available, secure, and maintainable database services. This is a senior engineering position with a focus on architecture, automation, documentation, and mentoring


Key Responsibilities

An architect highly available cloud-native MySQL and PostgreSQL clusters using Kubernetes Operators

Prototype and maintain Helm chartsKustomize for deployment of CNPG Percona Operator and supporting components

Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform

Implement and manage GitOps workflows using Argo CD

Lead design of backuprestore PITR, failover, and disaster recovery strategies

Tune query performance, replication, and storage behavior across platforms

Write clear production-ready documentation, SOPs, and runbooks for L2 teams

Lead end-to-end delivery of DB engineering projects, escalating only when needed


Core Qualifications

PostgreSQL technical experience

WAL internals PITR logical replication

Performance tuning and optimization

VACUUMautovacuum tuning query planning index optimization

Extensions pgstatstatements pgvector FDW

Operator deployment via CNPG

MySQL technical experience

Deep InnoDB understanding redo logs, buffer pool tuning

Performance tuning and optimization

GTID replication semisync RDSAurora HA topologies

Backup via Percona XtraBackup logical dumps snapshots

Operator-based deployment with Percona Operator

Automation and IaC

Experience using Argo CD for GitOps-style deployment

Helm chartKustomize creation and management

Deep Terraform proficiency for cloud infrastructure automation

Strong Python skills to build reusable automation libraries and scripts

Infrastructure Cloud

Experience with one of AWS, Azure, or OCI clouds is a must

Understanding of cloud-native database deployments, RDS, IAM secrets, and network security

Strong grasp of Kubernetes networking, RBAC, Stateful Sets, volumes, and node affinity

Operational Excellence

Project ownership from design through delivery and L2 handoff

Strong documentation skills, SOPs, diagrams, and runbooks

Excellent troubleshooting and root cause analysis under pressure

Ability to mentor L2 engineers and oversee their execution


Bonus Skills

Kubernetes secrets management: Sealed Secrets, External Secrets

CICD patterns for DB change promotion, e.g., schema diffs

Load testing and benchmarking Sysbench pgbench

Familiarity with other engines, MongoDB, Redis, Elastic Cache, etc
